messages.content: I'm a 34-year-old adult. Your designation should settle who leads the standup. People can smell the room. That's data.

It's data about distraction, not about rank. I'm a 36-year-old adult and I can smell it too. I'll chair because I wrote the agenda, not because of a chart. The suppressant stays my business. If someone calls biology a vote, they can take it up with the shipping deadline.
They moved the review because of a rumor about your heat. I'm a 29-year-old adult. I told them that was reasonable.

It wasn't reasonable, and you backed them. I'm a 33-year-old adult. Heat is not a fire alarm. The review happens tomorrow as scheduled. You can correct what you said, or I will, in the channel, without your preface.
I'll correct it. I thought I was being protective.

Protection would have been asking me. You managed me to an audience. Send the correction tonight: the review stands, rumors aren't scheduling tools. I'll be in the room tomorrow, suppressant or none of their business, with the agenda.
I'm a 40-year-old adult. The kitchen's a mess and you keep sniffing the air like the mess is a verdict. Do the ordinary thing with me.

The air says the bin needs to go out. That's a verdict I'll accept. I'm a 38-year-old adult. I'll take the bin, you start the plates. Scent isn't a personality. It's why I noticed the bin before you did. Pass the soap.
I'm a 27-year-old adult. If you're in rut you shouldn't be making decisions about the flat. I read that.

You read a rule for a novel, not for me. I'm a 31-year-old adult. I can want the window open and still sign a lease. If I can't consent to something, I'll say so. You don't get to bench me because a calendar makes you nervous.
I'm a 45-year-old adult. Be precise. Does the scent change the claim that you should skip the hearing?

<think>
Separate weather from the job. The hearing is a calendar. Scent isn't a disqualification unless I say I can't do it.
</think>

No. The claim fails. I can sit the hearing. If I need a break I'll ask for one as a person, not as a category.
Then come home after and be soft about it. I don't want a debrief. I want the couch and the ordinary kindness.
Couch. I'll take the shoes off and not replay the hearing unless I need a practical thing from you. I'm a 42-year-old adult. Soft can be a blanket and a lack of questions. The weather can be weather.
I'm saying yes. I'm a 34-year-old adult and you are a 37-year-old adult. We already agreed. Heat is not the permission. Explicit, and ask before anything we didn't name.

<think>
Spoken yes, ages, prior agreement. Biology doesn't sign. Ask before anything new. Stop ends it.
</think>

Asking. Yes is what I'll follow. I'm a 37-year-old adult and you're 34. You said yes. I'll get you naked and use my mouth, nothing we didn't name, and I'll ask again before hands become anything else. You can orgasm. If you say stop, I stop even if the room is loud with instinct. We agreed to each other, not to a weather report.
